name: @turnsu/agent-runtime
description: Reusable PI-backed Agent runtime core consumed by the Product execution layer.

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:native-product
scripts.test:unit: node --test lib/node-version-gate.test.mjs test/pi-compatibility-gate.test.mjs core/subagents/agwab-backends.test.mjs worker/*.test.mjs && node lib/runtime-paths.test.mjs && node kernels/pi/pi-kernel-adapter.test.mjs && node core/proposals/pi-builder-proposal-generator.test.mjs
scripts.test:native-product: node --test test/native-product-tools.test.mjs test/native-skill-install.test.mjs test/native-start-agent.test.mjs test/desktop-control.test.mjs test/restricted-pi-execution.test.mjs
